channel.title: Lovett Counseling Journal
channel.description: Notes on trauma, burnout, relationships, and starting therapy, from Whitney Lovett, MA, LPC, CCTP, in Denver, Colorado.

item.title: When Help Has Hurt Before
item.description: For people who learned the hard way that asking for help can cost you. What trauma-informed therapy should look like when institutions have already let you down.

item.title: When Someone Else Decided You Should Be Here
item.description: What therapy is like when a court, an employer, or a family member is the reason you're going, and what a therapist can and can't report back.

item.title: What Actually Happens in a First Therapy Session
item.description: A plain walkthrough of a first therapy appointment: what you'll be asked, what you won't be asked, and how to tell whether a therapist is the right fit.

item.title: Does Insurance Cover Therapy in Colorado?
item.description: How out-of-network mental health benefits work in Colorado, what a superbill is, and the four questions to ask your plan before you decide therapy is out of reach.

item.title: Is Telehealth Therapy Right for You?
item.description: An honest look at virtual therapy in Colorado — how effective it is, what a session looks like, and how to know if telehealth is the right fit for you.

item.title: 5 Communication Patterns That Quietly Erode Relationships
item.description: Five common communication patterns that damage relationships over time, and how Denver couples therapy helps partners find their way back to each other.

item.title: What Trauma-Informed Care Actually Means
item.description: Trauma-informed care gets used constantly and explained rarely. Here's what it actually looks like in practice, and why it changes how healing happens.

item.title: Burnout or Just a Hard Season? How to Tell the Difference
item.description: Trouble telling burnout from a rough patch? A Denver trauma-informed therapist breaks down the real differences, the signs, and what actually helps.

item.title: How to Find a Trauma-Informed Therapist in Denver
item.description: Searching for a trauma-informed therapist in Denver? Here's what the term actually means, what to ask before your first session, and how to know it's a fit.
